title: Container Bookings: carrier roll compensation rate, cap and roll limit by tier
content:
## Scope
This table covers the Container Bookings product line and gives, per tier, the credit paid for a compensated carrier roll, the most roll compensation one booking may receive in total, and the number of carrier rolls on one booking that earn compensation.

## What each setting means
- **Compensation rate**: the credit for each compensated carrier roll, in USD per container.
- **Compensation cap**: the maximum total roll compensation on one booking, in USD per booking; this is the per-booking ceiling on roll compensation.
- **Compensated carrier rolls**: the number of carrier rolls on one booking that earn compensation.

## Tier table
| Tier | Compensation rate (USD per container) | Compensation cap (USD per booking) | Compensated carrier rolls |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 100.00 | 1500.00 | 1 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 200.00 | 3000.00 | 2 |
| AHL Premium Express | 350.00 | 5000.00 | 2 |

## Points of judgement
**Which tiers pay any roll compensation?** AHL Contract Priority, AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express. The two spot tiers and AHL Contract Booking are at 0.00 with no compensated roll.

**Which tier compensates the most rolls?** AHL Guaranteed Loading and AHL Premium Express each compensate up to 2 carrier rolls; AHL Contract Priority compensates 1.
